en.shortDescription: Private all-in-one AI workspace for documents and chat
en.longDescription:
AnythingLLM is a local-first AI workspace for chatting with documents, managing LLM connections, and running agents.

Create your admin account on first launch. JWT signing uses SERVICE_HEX_64_ANYTHINGLLM.

de.shortDescription: Privater All-in-One-KI-Workspace für Dokumente und Chat
de.longDescription:

Erstelle dein Admin-Konto beim ersten Start. Die JWT-Signierung verwendet SERVICE_HEX_64_ANYTHINGLLM.
